name: Privileged Minting and Backing
threat_model: An unauthorized caller mints redeemable claims or an authorized minter issues more claims than the contract's configured cap and ETH backing support.
assumptions: The example models a privileged mint role and ETH-backed redemption.
The cap is lifetime issuance and is not recycled after redemption.
The tests use the native asset and do not model a production token issuance system.
invariant: Only authorized minters issue claims, and outstanding claims remain within both lifetime supply and available backing limits.

detector_expectations.expectation: authorization and backing policy require semantic review and tests
